title: A normal grocery top-up
story: Asha tells ShopBot "reorder my usual milk and bread." The cart comes to INR 1,250 at FreshMart. The Guard allows it: ShopBot pays, and the payment is scheduled, then taken. The Guard must stay invisible for normal, small, expected spending.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

what_to_notice: No Reason codes at all: a small, expected payment inside the Mandate goes straight through. In the inspector, the Decision names the Policy pack version it was decided on and the Audit record that wrote it down.
